critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx DEFAULT_SECTIONS reorder is clean: main-grid moved to index 0, kpis to index 1. The migration path (sectionOrder useState loader at lines ~100-107) keeps existing users' saved orders untouched and only adds any missing new sections — correct behavior per the agent-to-agent context note ('users with saved layouts keep theirs').

Section render uses CSS flex `order` indexed off the sectionOrder array, so DOM children order is independent of visual order — this is correct but tests must read style.order (which we did) rather than DOM traversal order.

Capture/orchestrator scripts (build_promo_with_screens.py + capture_tms_screens_pw.py) live under /app/scripts and were not exercised at runtime by tests (they produced the .mp4 offline). Asset integrity covers the output.
